title: Vape Spot Blueberry E-Liquid 10ml
description: VapeSpot Blueberry delivers a sweet and mellow fruit profile that captures the comforting taste of summer berries. The inhale provides the soft, jammy taste of ripe Blueberry, offering a smooth and vibrant flavour foundation. This is followed by a clean, gentle exhale, resulting in a beautifully balanced and highly satisfying vape that is perfect for all-day use. Formulated with a balanced 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, this freebase e-liquid provides excellent versatility. It performs flawlessly in both Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) and Restricted Direct-to-Lung (RDL) devices, pairing perfectly with coils ranging from 0.6ohm to 1.8ohm. The freebase nicotine formulation ensures a more noticeable, traditional throat hit compared to nic salts, providing a reliable and familiar sensation. Manufactured in the UK, VapeSpot e-liquids are crafted to provide premium quality and authentic taste in a budget-friendly format. Available in 6mg and 12mg strengths, this collection offers a straightforward, accessible, and consistently flavoursome vaping experience.
